caroline.description: System settings: interface language, keyboard layouts, date, time, time zone and network time, and the mail and messenger accounts (Accounts)

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: The interface language, the enabled keyboard layouts, the available languages, and the date, time, time zone and network time (NTP) state

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: The mail and messenger accounts linked on the device (shared with Communicator): id, service, whose they are and their state

tools.name: remove_account
tools.description: Deletes a linked account by its id from get_accounts, with its stored messages (ask the owner first)

tools.name: open_accounts
tools.description: Opens Settings > Accounts, where the owner adds an account, edits one or deletes it; use it when the owner wants to add or change an account (their passwords and codes are typed by them)

tools.name: set_language
tools.description: Sets the interface language of the whole device (a code from get_settings, e.g. 'ru'); the Settings page reloads in it

tools.name: set_layouts
tools.description: Sets the enabled on-screen keyboard layouts: language codes separated by commas, at least one

tools.name: set_timezone
tools.description: Sets the time zone of the device: an IANA name such as 'Europe/Prague' or 'UTC'

tools.name: set_auto_time
tools.description: Turns automatic date and time (network time, NTP) on or off: 'true' or 'false'

tools.name: set_time
tools.description: Sets the date and time by hand, in the device's time zone (refused while automatic date and time is on): date as YYYY-MM-DD, time as HH:MM
